column1: # Game profile of FIFA 18 (Switch, base game v0)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# EA's FIFA engine for the Switch (EA basekit: AssetStream, RNA renderer "fifarna", Apt UI, EAThread), SDK 3.4.0, NVN. Modules main + subsdk0 (NVN's GLSLC, which main imports
# but never calls: nn::gfx::detail::GlslcDll is linked and unused) + sdk. The RomFS ships fifazf.nss, main's unstripped ELF (symbols and DWARF), useful for every crash report.
# RomFS: EA BIG4 archives (data0..7, datax, per-language .big, with .bh hash tables beside them); members chunk-compressed (chunkzip / chunzstd), datax.big's also EASF-encrypted.
# The shaders are 189 NXSHADER effects (.fxo: one whole GLSLC output each, a vertex + pixel program or a compute one) in data/fifarna/shader.big and shaderboot.big inside
# datax.big (shader_split.py ea_big_shaders, eabig.py: the EASF key comes from main's code).
# Status: profile from the survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py) with mem_used from the Android rewrite (a guess, see Memory); the run-time keys are not measured yet
# full: the right stick does skill moves
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = GLSLC)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the 4 GB block of the other games without virtual address memory
# (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region)
# the rewritten modules (111.5 MB on Android: main 86.2, subsdk0 14.4, sdk 10.9) are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (profile_guess.py mem_used).
# Not measured: the survey's guess from the rewrite's size, not the game's peak (open in the note)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; the NXSHADER effects in datax.big) ----
# integer-class shader images over RGBA8 read as raw R32 (vka_raw32.h): the GPU texture compressors load kits and faces with SULD.D .B32 (red kits and faces without it)
